original_benchmark.notes: Solo track, 20 in-game years, one task in the public reference world (seed 1). The paper averages over seeds 1, 1024 and 2026; the adapter replaces the other seeds with repeated attempts. The original harness is a custom per-stop LLM loop (runner/llm_agent.py), not a Harbor-compatible agent. The multi-agent Arena track is operated by the authors and is not adapted.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity not run yet. One parity run is one game of the task. Two metrics: s_final is the original composite score, uncapped; reward is clip(S_final / reference, 0, 1), where reference is the oracle's S_final in the same world.
